usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a coherent, well-sourced picture: Freixe's identity, EDHEC education, ~40-year Nestlé career through Zone Europe/Latin America, his September 2024 appointment as CEO replacing Mark Schneider, and his September 1, 2025 dismissal after an investigation found an undisclosed romantic relationship with a direct subordinate, with no exit package, Philipp Navratil as successor, and a 2026 legal dispute over lost bonuses and shares. A reader clearly learns who he is and what he did. The status labels (contested/claimed/unknown) flag uncertainty throughout, but the dossier never consolidates its gaps and, worse, carries 'supported' claims that he is currently CEO when its own citations are dismissal coverage — so it implies completeness in places where it is stale.
